headline: Everybody is talking about honeypot! Was it a honeypot always or merely at the end, as a form of circumstance? America tells Nvidia: you are married to national security, you must not sell your most powerful chips to China. But in the same breath it says: you are the great hero of American capitalism! Sell as many chips as possible! And Jensen says: of course, darling, I will be faithful. Then, late at night, *sniffs* he finds a way to remain faithful. So you see, Jensen is not cheating on the system. Cheating on his wife? Yes. The system? No. He is the only one who has been faithful to it! The system itself wants two incompatible things: to contain China and to dominate the Chinese market. And now we are shocked, shocked, that somebody got caught in a compromising position. *sniffs* And so on. This is the true infidelity. This is the real honeypot.
